newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery hires three in high-yield expansion.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery hires three in high-yield expansion.

text.p: Montgomery Securities on Wednesday announced it hired three high-yield market professionals, including Peter Wilson, former senior managing director at Bear Stearns Cos Inc's Bear, Stearns & Co Inc unit, as part of a major expansion into the market.

Other hires by Montgomery are Rob Long, former executive managing director of Nomura Securities Co Ltd's Nomura Securities Inc affiliate's high-yield department, and Lee Stern, former managing director of high-yield finance at Nomura.

Wilson will become managing director and director of high-yield trading at Montgomery effective February 1, Montgomery said. He joined Bear Stearns in 1985 and ran the high-yield trading desk for two years.
Calls to Bear, Stearns were not immediately returned.

Long, a managing director with CS First Boston prior to Nomura, is managing director and director of strategic investing and bridge financing. And Stern, who has worked at Kidder, Peabody and Drexel Burnham Lambert, will work with Long in the operation of the bridge fund, Montgomery said.
Long and Stern joined Montgomery on January 27.
